motivation: The fine-type oracle is goal-scale, while explicit additive priors fail despite a positive 0.18-0.23 correlation with the oracle. A second-stage exact-C outcome tree may use the full probability simplex conditionally and ignore harmful directions instead of forcing a signed additive correction.

source_protocol.history: season strictly less than source year
source_protocol.comparison: same-year exact-C parent with no fine probability columns

stage1.target: normalized tagged fine pitch type on historically matched official TrackMan rows
stage1.family: three deterministic cross-fitted CatBoost MultiClass models
stage1.training_probability: a labeled history row is predicted only by the fold model that excluded it; unmatched rows use the fold mean
stage1.validation_probability: mean of the same three outer-history fold models

stage2.addition: eight fine-type probabilities plus row entropy and maximum probability

next_step_if_fail: close fine-pitch deployable selector axis without opening 2022+
